The '''KynachTech Industries''' was a techno factory on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kynachi]]. In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] the world was seized by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], and the [[Skakoan/Legends|Skakoan]] Overseer [[Umbrag]] took over the KynachTech Industries, replacing it with the [[KynachTech factory]], and also imposing a frequency jammer on the world.
